name: WebSync Checkout for Elementor
author: WebSync Team

sections.description:
Transform your WooCommerce checkout experience with WebSync Checkout for Elementor. Replace the standard checkout with a beautifully designed, fully customizable checkout page that integrates seamlessly with your Elementor-built website.

Key Features

  • Full Design Control – Style every aspect of your checkout form using Elementor’s intuitive controls
  • Responsive Layout – One-column or two-column checkout layouts optimized for all devices
  • Modern Design – Clean, professional checkout interface tailored to your brand
  • Performance Optimized – Lightweight code that ensures fast checkout flow
  • Easy Setup – Drag and drop the widget into Elementor—no coding required

Layout Options

  • One Column Layout – Traditional stacked layout perfect for mobile-first design
  • Two Column Layout – Modern split layout with forms on left, order summary on right
  • Sticky Order Summary – Order review sticks to viewport for better user experience
  • Customizable Spacing – Control gaps, padding, and margins for perfect alignment

Style Controls

  • Container Styles – Background, padding, borders, and shadows
  • Form Section Styles – Individual styling for billing, shipping, and order sections
  • Typography Controls – Full control over fonts, sizes, colors, and spacing
  • Button Styles – Customize place order button and all form buttons
  • Field Styles – Style input fields, labels, and form elements
  • Table Styles – Customize order summary table appearance

Support

For support, please:
1. Check the FAQ section above
2. Visit our support forum at https://websync.tech/contact/
3. Create an issue on GitHub

Please include your:
* WordPress version
* Elementor version
* WooCommerce version
* PHP version
* Any relevant error messages

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPL v2 or later.

Credits

  • Built for the Elementor community
  • Compatible with WooCommerce
  • Thanks to all contributors and testers

A Note on Compatibility

You need:
* WordPress: 5.0 or higher
* Elementor: Free version 3.0+
* WooCommerce: 4.0 or higher
* PHP: 7.4 or higher
It should work with future versions but always test before updating on production sites.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/websync-checkout-for-elementor directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Create or edit your checkout page with Elementor
  4. Drag the “WooCommerce Checkout” widget onto your page
  5. Configure the widget settings to match your design needs
sections.faq:
What do I need to use this plugin?

You need:
* WordPress 5.0 or higher
* Elementor Free
* WooCommerce 4.0 or higher

Can I use this with any theme?

Yes! This plugin works with any WordPress theme that supports Elementor.

Will this affect my existing checkout functionality?

No, this widget only changes the appearance of your checkout page. All WooCommerce functionality, payment gateways, and shipping methods will continue to work exactly as before.

Can I customize the fields?

The widget uses WooCommerce’s standard checkout fields. You can modify fields using WooCommerce hooks or plugins like “Checkout Field Editor.”

Is this mobile-friendly?

Yes! The layout automatically adapts to mobile devices with optimized one-column view.

What if I encounter issues?

  1. Make sure WooCommerce is properly configured
  2. Check that your checkout page is set in WooCommerce settings
  3. Ensure Elementor is updated to the latest version
  4. Try disabling other plugins to check for conflicts
